sounds.text: The whistle, effects and ambience play after your first tap. A phone can quiet them when locked, on silent or out of sight.

nudgesOn.text: On. When a brew or tea break ends while Kettle is open but out of sight, I’ll nudge you. If Kettle is closed or your phone has paused it by then, no nudge comes.

keepAwake.text: Stops your screen dimming while a brew runs on screen.
